name: io.github.tarazou9/garnet-mcp
title: garnet-mcp
description: RAG memory for LLM agents over Garnet Vector Sets: store text as embeddings, recall by meaning.

garnet_host.description: Hostname of the Garnet (or any Redis-compatible) server. Defaults to 127.0.0.1 when left blank.

garnet_port.description: Port of the Garnet server. Defaults to 6379 when left blank.

embeddings_provider.description: Embedding provider: 'AzureOpenAI' for real embeddings, or 'Fake' for a deterministic offline provider (no external calls).

embeddings_endpoint.description: Azure OpenAI endpoint, e.g. https://YOUR-RESOURCE.openai.azure.com/ (required when Embeddings__Provider=AzureOpenAI). Authenticated keyless via DefaultAzureCredential.

embeddings_deployment.description: Azure OpenAI embedding deployment name, e.g. text-embedding-3-small.

embeddings_dimensions.description: Embedding vector dimensions, e.g. 1536 for text-embedding-3-small.
